tasks.title: Fix job pause/resume lifecycle race
actions: Introduce a Pausing state or lease-owner guard for running jobs.
Block resume while the job is still registered as running.
Separate cooperative pause from final cancellation.
verify: Resume only after cancellation has fully completed.
tasks.result: Added a Pausing job state, finalized cooperative pauses in the worker before allowing resume, blocked API resume while pause cancellation is still registered or in progress, and covered queue, worker, endpoint, and maxParallelJobs behavior with tests.

tasks.title: Make document import deduplication atomic
actions: Audit existing duplicate document rows.
Add a unique database constraint or equivalent transactional guard for non-null sha256 values.
Handle duplicate import conflicts without creating shared-file delete hazards.
tasks.result: Added schema version 11 with an audited unique partial index for non-null document sha256 values, handled concurrent import insert conflicts as deduplicated imports, and prevented original-file deletion while another document row still references the same path.

tasks.title: Fix OCR bridge process I/O, timeout, and cancellation behavior
actions: Read stdout and stderr concurrently.
Add explicit timeouts to OCR check, prepare, and recognize operations.
Terminate the process tree on cancellation or timeout.
tasks.result: Updated PaddleOcrEngine to read stdout and stderr concurrently, apply explicit per-operation bridge timeouts, kill the process tree on timeout or cancellation, and surface invalid JSON diagnostics. Added process-backed tests for large stderr output, hung bridge timeout, cancellation kill, and invalid stdout.

tasks.title: Move signing material out of the repository workspace
actions: Remove local PFX and password files from the repository tree.
Require an explicit external certificate path or secure prompt/environment variable.
Keep only non-secret certificate documentation in the repo.
verify: Run signing with an external certificate path.
Confirm no signing secret remains under the repository root.
tasks.result: Removed ignored local PFX, password, public certificate export, and local code-signing helper files from certificates\app, leaving only the tracked non-secret README and .gitkeep. Confirmed the signing script requires an explicit external PFX path or installed certificate thumbprint, rejects repository-local certificate paths, and reaches certificate import only for an explicit external PFX path. Full trusted signing remains covered by release-gate TASK-012.
checks: pwsh .\scripts\Sign-Release.ps1 -CertificatePath $env:TEMP\OnlyRag-external-test.pfx -SkipReleaseVerification with ONLYRAG_CERT_PASSWORD set to a non-secret dummy value

tasks.title: Replace or harden Ollama remote installer execution
actions: Remove or gate the irm | iex PowerShell path.
Prefer manual installation guidance or a pinned, verified installer flow.
Show clear offline and enterprise-policy errors in the UI.
verify: Verify no unpinned remote script is executed automatically.
tasks.result: Replaced the Ollama installer action with a manual download-page launch. The backend no longer starts PowerShell, no longer passes ExecutionPolicy Bypass, and no longer executes irm/iex remote installer content. UI and docs now describe manual installation and include offline/enterprise-policy guidance.
checks: rg -n "irm https://ollama\.com/install\.ps1|\| iex|ExecutionPolicy\s+Bypass" -S src tests README.md docs packaging scripts

tasks.title: Reduce unauthenticated health metadata exposure
actions: Keep only a minimal unauthenticated liveness endpoint.
Move vector backend and embedding counters behind authenticated diagnostics.
verify: Call health endpoints without a token.
Call diagnostics with and without a token.
tasks.result: Kept /health as the only unauthenticated liveness endpoint and reduced it to a minimal healthy status. Removed /api/health from the authentication bypass and moved vector backend metadata, persistence, limits, and embedding counts to the authenticated /api/diagnostics/vector-health endpoint. Updated the Documents UI and architecture docs to use the authenticated diagnostics path.

tasks.title: Add frontend unit, component, and e2e coverage
actions: Add tests for Chat, Documents, Settings, error states, and persisted WebView storage.
Add an e2e smoke path for import, job state, backend offline, and preview modal.
verify: Run typecheck, lint, format check, and build.
tasks.result: Added Vitest/jsdom unit and component coverage for API client behavior, WebView exit lifecycle storage, Chat, Documents, Settings, settings helper normalization, error states, and persisted chat draft/session data. Added a Playwright smoke test with a mocked local backend covering document import, active job state, backend offline handling, and preview modal rendering. Integrated the frontend test script into the canonical repository gate and documented the new commands.

tasks.title: Split oversized mixed-responsibility files
actions: Split SettingsSection into focused settings panels.
Split DocumentIngestionService by document strategy.
Split InProcessBackend DI, middleware, endpoint, and helper responsibilities.
verify: Run canonical gate after each split batch.
tasks.result: Split SettingsSection rendering into focused settings panel components behind a thin container/context, split DocumentIngestionService into partial strategy files for text, PDF/OCR, Office, and progress helpers, and split InProcessBackend startup, DI, auth, endpoint helpers, document import validation, translation helpers, and error mapping into focused partial files.

tasks.title: Normalize API contracts and error responses
actions: Add OpenAPI or contract tests for critical backend/frontend DTOs.
Standardize error response shape and status codes.
Avoid surfacing raw external exception details to the UI.
verify: Run frontend typecheck against generated or tested contracts.
tasks.result: Centralized API ProblemDetails creation with stable code extensions, normalized not-found/conflict/validation/auth/unexpected error responses to application/problem+json, stopped surfacing raw Ollama external error bodies to the UI, added backend/frontend contract coverage for critical DTO and error shapes, and split document pipeline/preview endpoints out of the main document endpoint controller.

tasks.title: Improve polling, stale-state, and shutdown UX
actions: Surface repeated polling failures in the UI.
Track last successful refresh time.
Do not treat active-job API failure as zero active jobs during app exit.
verify: Exit while active jobs endpoint fails.
tasks.result: Added shared frontend refresh-state tracking with consecutive failure counts and last successful refresh timestamps, surfaced repeated stale polling failures in backend, documents, and jobs UI while preserving the last known data, hardened WebView exit state so active-job polling failures are treated as unknown active work instead of zero jobs, and updated WPF shutdown confirmation to preserve that unknown-job guard.
checks: npm run test:unit -- appLifecycle.test.ts DocumentsSection.test.tsx ChatSection.test.tsx

tasks.title: Add database status constraints and migration checks
actions: Add CHECK constraints or equivalent validation for job and translation statuses.
Create migration checks for existing invalid statuses.
Align code enum-like transitions with database constraints.
verify: Run job and translation lifecycle tests.

actions: Sign the installer with trusted signing material outside Git.
Run installer install, first launch, upgrade if applicable, rollback, uninstall, and SmartScreen/signature checks on a clean machine.
verify: Confirm Authenticode signature and timestamp validation.

Repeat at least once with non-default accessibility text settings.
verify: Record screenshots or exact observations for every wizard page.
Confirm no clipping, overlap, or unreadable controls.

Verify document import, active jobs, retrieval/chat, translation records, settings persistence, and shutdown behavior with representative data.
verify: Run with Ollama-backed workflows when in release scope.
Capture exact defects and reproduction steps.

Re-run relevant targeted tests for every fixed audit finding.
Promote the artifact only if P0 tasks are complete and P1 residual risk is explicitly accepted.
verify: Confirm no unresolved P0 audit finding remains.
